233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

5784|1a4f8770.name: Waldor
5784|1a4f8770.text: Your understanding of leather is deeper than my own. Perhaps you should visit the tauren Krulmoo Fullmoon in Camp Taurajo of the Barrens. He has much knowledge to offer a student of your talents.

1486-complete.name: Nalpak
1486-complete.text:
Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, $N.

Thank you for your dedication.
1486-complete.title: Deviate Hides

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

1487-accept.name: Ebru
1487-accept.text:
Naralex had a noble goal.

Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.

Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.

While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.

Brave the caverns, $N, and eradicate the deviate spawn.
1487-accept.title: Deviate Eradication

64-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-complete.text:
My watch!  Thank you so much, kind lady! 

We are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
64-complete.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom
